notes: Native firmware 0.1.19 — THE MQTT-CONNECT CRASH FIX: every display write held a portMUX critical section (interrupts disabled) across uart_write_bytes, which BLOCKS when the transmit ring fills. The retained-message burst at every MQTT connect (the screensaver's style commands, the clock, the weather) filled the ring and the write waited with interrupts disabled — the interrupt watchdog (300 ms) aborted the chip. The critical section is gone: the writes serialize on a blocking-safe FreeRTOS mutex.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
